methods: Read all narration and all 138 English prompts, including description/title/outro and all 25 loop pairs. Compared ID, order, text and source rows between video, script, narration projection and claims.

Reopened frozen raw HTML, JSON and original PDFs, verified every used anchor hash and locator; reproduced PDF page text with pdftotext -layout to stdout. Checked all 21 supplied original-language short quotes, including whitespace-only PDF normalization.
Viewed original photo files PHOTO_FAX, PHOTO_SHROUD, PHOTO_DRAWING and PHOTO_PRODUCTION and original rendered patent/UKIPO pages; source photographs remain research evidence, not generated output.
Used pure composeShotPrompt, shotCast, shotAppearancePrompt, resolveLook, keyframeKey and Stage.imageKey methods on both ends of both reuse pairs. No provider invocation or media/cache mutation.

must_fix.current_text: 戴森在後來口述裡，把取得Apex授權放在一九八六年。
must_fix.problem: 取得Apex授權 reads as Dyson receiving a licence from Apex and reverses the rights relationship described in the sources. The oral account only says he got a licensing agreement with Apex; the Japanese account explicitly has him offer Japanese sales rights in exchange for making the machine there.

source_locations.quote: I got a licensing agreement with a little Japanese company named Apex, so we had some income coming in.
日本で作ってくれるなら販売の権利を譲る

must_fix.suggested_exact_text: 戴森在後來口述裡，把與Apex達成授權協議放在一九八六年。
must_fix.required_propagation: Author should rebuild all narration/script/claims/runtime projections and refreeze, then obtain a new source review of the changed input. Keep the frozen original research unchanged; add a correction/override for its inherited got-Apex-licence caveat instead of treating that caveat as evidence.
must_fix.scope: One narration fact/role correction; dates remain attributed and no exact signing day is asserted.

source_evidence_readings.independent_reading: Fortune paragraph 35 supports attributed 1986 licensing agreement with Apex, niche G-Force at quarter-million yen, some income and Apex not very successful. Does not show Dyson receiving Apex-owned technology rights.
Interview paragraph 46 says unfinished prototype and proposal to make it again in Japan in exchange for sales rights. Dyson grants rights, Apex receives Japanese sales rights.
Interview paragraphs 46/48 describe import stationery business, no engineers or factory, president finding a factory; own biography is same participant, not independent corroboration.
Interview paragraph 48 explicitly states same-power 100V motor was considerably larger and housing needed redesign; no invented motor model, watts or measured dimensions.

Interview paragraph 58 explicitly describes perforated shroud, inlet blockage, added part, testing hole size/shape, debris rotating while air enters. No invented aperture measurement or universal repair.
Fortune paragraph 40 supports attributed 1993 Mike Page / Lloyds tooling loan of US$1 million and mail-order catalogues then John Lewis. No independent loan document obtained.
Official caption says first DC01 production line at Bumpers Farm Chippenham 1993; original photo shows multiple machines, workers and boxes, without throughput inference.
Named participant sponsored interview says 1984 US Product Design book picture; script attributes this and does not claim to possess the book page.
Cyclon precedes Japanese G-Force; 1983–84 and 550 remain attributed to Dyson, not a production ledger.
SMG object text explicitly says Made in Italy for Kleeneze Rotork Limited, Bristol; no claim of UK manufacture.
UKIPO O/295/02 page 4 paragraph 16 records Dyson testimony about wooden visual model and August 1983 transparent-bin prototype; attribution retained.
Fortune paragraph 34 gives distinct patent-counsel and product-line obstacles; script does not adopt his unsupported motive assessment or all-world rejection.
UKIPO original page 4 paragraph 17 says 15 manufacturers in 1980s, not major issue at the time and more than one expressed dislike; script does not turn this into all 15.
Own professional biography says joined Apex in 1985 and joint UK development; world-first marketing wording excluded.
Original Japanese interview paragraph 51 directly says precision machinery factory, not vacuum specialist; Yamamoto had not designed vacuum cleaners.
Half-year plus subsequent year-and-half are approximate participant recollection; no precise calendar derived.
Paragraph 50 supports heavy motor, carpet grip, split tyre and blockage/overheat/melted housing. Script separates recalled problems and supplies no unsupported repair.

Original US4593429 front page and columns 1–2 visually reread: June 10 1986 grant, larger debris retention and upstream low-efficiency / downstream high-efficiency arrangement. This is a patent proposal, not verified G-Force bill of materials.
Original US4373228 front page and abstract visually reread: UK priority 1979-04-19, US grant 1983-02-15, cyclone and dirt chamber.
Same original patent column 2 says exhausted if necessary through a final filter; script does not equate bagless with filterless.

Interview paragraphs 54/56/58 support design sheets, fax exchanges, factory/drawing/experiment work and several 1–2-week visits. Photograph shows sheets/fax material but cannot alone establish transmission chronology.
Original Japanese interview paragraph 56 says he was contractually responsible for problems and finishing drawings; script attributes participant recollection, not an inspected executed contract.

anchors.short_quote_original_language: 図面を仕上げなくてはなりませんでした

source_evidence_readings.independent_reading: Official caption says Nishiazabu Japan 1985 and cleaner-head redesign; original photograph visibly shows seated drafting work, without proving a signing date.

1986 release is explicitly reported by the article; V&A records a 1986 Japan-made object. Neither catalogue nor caption proves a precise signing date. Frozen caveat saying got Apex licence is overridden by MF-01: the source says a licensing agreement with Apex.
M+ 1983 / Silver Seiko manufacturer; V&A 1986 / APEX manufacturer / Japan; SMG 1985–1990 / Apex manufacturing. Script keeps different objects and catalogue roles separate.
Same decision paragraph 17 records his account of many potential retailers in 1993 disliking clear bin and his reasons to retain it; no universal rejection claimed.

projection_and_reference_checks.duration_note: 3300 units and 4–5 units/s are planning arithmetic only. Required unwrapped voiced body is 720–840s including cold open and voiced CTA; added 5s/21s branding is separate.

remaining_limits: This HOLD is not independent native/blind narrative acceptance, owner approval, pronunciation review, actual voice listening, generated image judgement or film QA.
No actual audio, timed captions, generated story images, music, final cut, post-crop equal image files or actual 12–14 minute duration were inspected.

Most Japanese development details are named participant recollection in a sponsored 2014 interview. Fortune is Dyson first-person retrospective; museums establish object catalogue fields, not contracts or first-sale chronology.
1985 Nishiazabu work, 1986 oral licensing recollection and release account remain separate. M+ 1983, V&A 1986 and SMG 1985–1990 do not imply one common manufacturing/launch date.
No precise wheel/overheat repair, measured shroud hole size, executed licence, royalty agreement, retail invoice or original bank loan document has been established.
BAILII HTTP 200 challenge pages are unusable judgment text; they are not source support for this script. No court-full-text claim is made from EPO summaries.
The exact new-project US$25 account, protected admission, full all-in quote and ordinary production/owner gates remain separate. Free preparation or this receipt authorizes no spending.

native_facts_marker.reason: MF-01 remains in the frozen exact input; no verify-1.md may imply source PASS.

rows.text: 你會花約二十五萬日圓，買一台吸塵器嗎？
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這是戴森後來回憶的日本價位；你若回到開發桌，先遇到的卻是未完成樣品。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 山本秀夫回憶，Apex社長得設法找工廠，把新的開發工作交給設計師。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 一顆一百伏特的馬達換進設計，外殼卻得重畫。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 我好奇的是，一個滿身小孔的罩子，後來怎麼擋住入口的麻煩？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 而有了日本的授權收入，英國那副量產模具又得向誰籌錢？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 今天沿著戴森這筆跨國合作，追到一九九三年的自家產線。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 日本這一站，究竟替他完成了什麼？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本在二〇一四年的贊助訪談裡回憶，Apex社長看到粉紅吸塵器照片，便聯絡戴森。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他說，照片出自美國一九八四年的設計書，書名直譯是產品設計。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這位原想進口的社長，必須先決定，要不要接下後續的重新開發。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 換成你原本要進貨，我想你也會問：現在到底是買產品，還是接開發案？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 在山本的敘述裡，合作方向就此轉成在日本重新製作，再取得銷售權。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 但先等等，這能說成英國全都拒絕，只有日本願意製造嗎？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森自己的回顧裡，在日本這一站之前，已有英國授權商的Cyclon。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他把生產時間列在一九八三、八四年，並說只做了五百五十台。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他也說，那次合作在商業上沒有成功。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你若問這台英國授權的機器在哪裡做，館藏又怎麼寫？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 館方標明它在義大利製造，為位於英國布里斯托的授權商生產。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 英國智慧財產局記錄的本人證詞，還留下一個更早的動作：先做木製外觀模型。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他說，到一九八三年八月，已做出帶透明集塵筒的氣旋原型。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 外觀模型、能工作的原型、授權商品，在這段路上已經是不同的物件。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 有了授權與成品，為什麼別的合作還是談不下去？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 我反而覺得這比全世界都說不，更接近做產品的難處。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 有人答應合作，只是起點；換一個合作方，也不會自動省掉開發。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 那麼，其他授權談判，到底是在哪裡停下來？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森在口述裡說，有些公司本來很有興趣，談判也進行了很長一段。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 有的談到公司內部的專利法律顧問，才被擋下。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 也有公司決定不增加產品線，因此停止接洽。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這些是他回顧的談判障礙，各家停下的地方並不相同。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 我想，換成你拿透明筒展示給別家做，會不會先被外觀擋住？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 那份官方決定書裡，他還說，八十年代曾向十五家吸塵器製造商展示透明筒機器。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 透明筒當時不是主要爭點，但他記得，不只一家製造商表達過不喜歡。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 展示機器的對象、產品線的決定和專利審視，會把合作帶往不同方向。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: Apex接下來找誰，把眼前的樣品變成能做的東西？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本說，這家公司原本擅長進口文具，沒有自家的工程師和工廠。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 找得到生產地點，下一個問題是：現場有沒有人做過吸塵器？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本的工作室履歷，也把加入Apex寫在一九八五年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 履歷列出的工作，是和英國團隊共同開發吸塵器。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 山本說，承接製造的原本是一間精密機械工廠，並不專門做吸塵器。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 而他自己在這以前，也沒有設計吸塵器的經驗。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你找到的是能製造零件的夥伴，還得一起摸索這台工具怎麼用得起來。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 你若先照外形開工，原設計遇到的電壓差異，會在哪個零件讓人停下來？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 進口公司、設計師和外部工廠，得先把各自的工作接起來。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 那個馬達，為什麼又會把外殼牽進來？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本說，他們得在日本使用的電壓條件下，找到輸出相近的馬達。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 結果找到的馬達，尺寸比原先的大了一截。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你可以把馬達拿在手上比較，問題卻不只在那一顆零件。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 我先想到的是，這顆大馬達裝好以後，地毯上的操作會怎麼變？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 依山本多年後的估計，做出第一台日本試作品，大約花了半年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 之後還有約一年半，都在處理陸續出現的問題。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這是他回顧時的粗略工期，不是一份逐月排好的工程日誌。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 他記得，裝起來才發現，大馬達不只是體積大，也很重。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 機器拿到地毯上操作，會吸住地毯，難以前進。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 硬往前推，還曾經把輪子推裂。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你平常只想把地掃乾淨，我聽到這裡卻先擔心：它能不能順利移動？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本還提到另一種狀況：雜物堵住，馬達過熱，甚至使外殼熔損。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這些是試作過程裡不同問題的回憶，不能拼成同一台的一場事故。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 沒有集塵袋，空氣經過的地方，為什麼還是會堵？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 要看懂下一個改件，得先把灰塵走過的路分開。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 一份一九八六年核准的美國專利，就把家用雜物的問題寫進說明。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 它談的是戴森的氣旋設計，遇到粗雜物和細灰時，該怎麼分工。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你也許會問，有了專利，為什麼還會有那麼多樣機工作？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 更早一份美國專利的首頁，已列出一九七九年的英國優先權。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 那份美國申請到一九八三年獲准，摘要寫了氣旋分離和集塵室。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 文件把方案留下來，地毯卻會讓實際使用的問題跑出來。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 而專利本身也繼續處理細節，並不是一句無袋就把所有工作做完。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 你在地上吸起來的，難道每一樣都和細灰一樣小嗎？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 專利指出，高效率氣旋若單獨處理較大的雜物，東西可能滯留、干擾運作。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 我覺得這個問題很實在：家裡的地板，不會先替吸塵器把垃圾分好。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 它提出的辦法，是前面先用低效率氣旋，後面再接高效率氣旋。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 前段先處理較粗的雜物，細灰再交給後段。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這裡的效率是在講分離工作，並不是說前段可以隨便做。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 同一份說明裡，最後的氣流仍然可以經過濾網。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 所以無袋，並不是整台沒有任何濾網，更不是每條通道都不會堵。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 專利說的是當時提出的方案；日本樣機的入口問題，要回到山本的工作。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 外圍旋轉的氣流，要進到裡面的錐體，入口怎麼辦？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本指著一個有小孔的部件，說那是入口的孔罩。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他說，若少了它，雜物容易堵在氣流進入錐體的入口。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 依他的回憶，他們把這個部件加進去，再試驗孔的大小和形狀。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 要讓雜物繼續在外圍轉動，空氣則能經過入口往內走。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你看得到的是一圈小孔，我更想知道的是：孔改了，通過的東西會怎麼變？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本說，他們靠這些實驗，解決了那個入口的堵塞問題。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這是入口這一件工作的答案，不是輪子、重量與所有過熱情況的通用解方。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 但設計的人分處兩國，這些要改的地方，怎麼送到對方手上？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本說，戴森人在英國時，他們就一再用傳真往返。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 那篇訪談也放了工程圖紙和傳真頁的照片。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你可以把合作想成這些紙張接著實驗走，不只是一份合約放在抽屜裡。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本回憶，他和戴森一起到工廠、畫圖，也一起做實驗。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 我喜歡這裡終於看得到工作的樣子：要改的東西，得落到圖面和現物上。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 依山本對合作約定的回憶，這些圖面和問題，最後仍由誰負責完成？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森也負有解決問題、完成圖面的責任。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 圖面還得完成，發現的問題要有人接著處理，工廠才能繼續往前做。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 隔著傳真還不夠，他本人有沒有到日本工作？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 山本說，為了走到能販售的階段，戴森曾數度來日本。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 每次停留的時間，依他回憶，大約是一到兩週。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 戴森官網還有一張製圖照片，圖說把地點列為東京西麻布。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 圖說寫的是一九八五年，正在重新設計後來G-Force的吸頭。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 照片裡能看見人坐在製圖板前工作。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 那麼，合作的開始、授權的簽訂、商品推出，是不是同一個時間點？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 先別把它們擠進同一格日曆。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森在後來口述裡，把取得Apex授權放在一九八六年。
rows.note: MF-01: licence direction mistranslated.

rows.text: 而官網圖說記的日本改圖工作，更早一年就已經在進行。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 能穩妥接起來的，是八十年代中期的合作過程，而不是一個精確簽約日。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 對你來說，最後要等的是櫃台能買到；我也想問：那部商品何時出現？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 這篇訪談把日本G-Force的發售，放在一九八六年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 英國V&A收藏的一件，也記為一九八六年、日本製造。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 但一件館藏的生產年份，不能直接充當一份完整的首售紀錄。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 如果你再找另一家博物館，會拿到完全相同的標籤嗎？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 香港M+把它的物件日期列為一九八三年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 科學博物館群的另一件，則列一九八五到一九九〇年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 這些是各館對所藏物件的記錄，不能挑最早的數字，就宣布那年已上市。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 日期不同之外，製造者是不是也都寫同一家？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: M+另外列出Silver Seiko，其他館則列Apex。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 我會留住這些不同欄位，免得把進口公司的名字，直接當成它有一座自家工廠。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 產品終於走到市場，接下來是不是就成了暢銷故事？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森在二〇一七年的口述裡，稱它是小眾商品。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他還說，Apex賣這台機器，並沒有取得很大的商業成功。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 但授權合作，確實替他帶來了一些收入。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你如果站在開發者那一邊，會先看見收入終於進來。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 可是收得到授權收入，和自己備好量產模具，還是兩件工作。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 下一步回到英國，誰願意先把模具的錢借給他？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森回憶，到了一九九三年，銀行經理麥克佩奇替他向萊斯銀行爭取貸款。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 那筆錢要用來準備模具；他說，這才讓自己能投入生產。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他說銀行最後答應借一百萬美元，這是他口述時記下的金額。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 換成你要開始做一批產品，我也會先問：錢到位以後，現場在哪裡？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 戴森自傳網站的一張照片，把第一條自家直立式吸塵器產線標在一九九三年。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 地點是英國奇彭納姆的邦帕斯農場。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 照片裡，多台機器排在工作線上，旁邊有人工作，也有紙箱。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 到這裡，設計之外已經有了模具資金，也有一個能組裝、裝箱的生產現場。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 有了產線和箱子，通路就一定願意把機器擺上架嗎？
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 英國智慧財產局的一份決定書，記下戴森對一九九三年的回憶。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 他說，不少潛在零售商不喜歡透明的集塵筒。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 你家吸起來的灰塵，真的要讓人直接看見嗎？我能理解這個猶豫。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 但他認為，使用者能看見灰塵的位置、理解運作，還能直接看見清掃的效果。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 依這份證詞，他仍選擇保留透明的設計。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 在那篇口述裡，他先找到一家郵購目錄買貨，之後再有第二家。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 後來，英國百貨公司約翰路易斯開始販售，也才接到更多通路。
rows.note: Read against original anchors; attribution and qualifications retained.

rows.text: 日本合作補上的是把樣品推向商品的開發；我看來，它沒有替往後的資金與通路省下工作。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 如果換成你接下這個案子，會先守住哪一步，才敢把產品交出去？留言告訴我。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.

rows.text: 想繼續看日用品怎麼跨過這些實際難關，就訂閱品牌故事。
rows.note: Question, opinion, connection or invitation read in context; no additional unsupported factual claim.
